intro: Call of Earth is an elemental rite of passage for young shaman in the snowy reaches of Dun Morogh. By communing with the local earth spirits, initiates receive a rough quartz to bring to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar. This simple stone proves their communion and serves as the core of their Earth Totem.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.
Be patient, friend. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ahh, ye've returned. If ye have the stone, it means the mountain's chosen ye true. I'll give ye the totem it promised. But if ye've come empty-handed, off with ye! The path ain't for those who forget their way.
